photo: Shot on a full-frame camera, natural colour, fine film grain, true-to-life materials with tiny real-world imperfections, honest exposure. No people, no text, no lettering, no readable signs, no logos, no watermark, no border.
same: Keep the exact same camera position, lens, framing and perspective, and keep everything that stays exactly where and as it is.
negative: text, logos, watermark, cuts, jump cuts, flicker, distortion, melting, warping, morphing, extra windows, cartoon
